**A2 CLOSED (CP-A2a merged): GitLab governance pipeline fixture-tested — 3-PR chain #232/#233/#234; CP-A2b (live e2e) is next as a runbook-lite against the gitlab.com mirror**

What: CP-A2a APPROVED + merged by the human. A2 (GitLab governance pipeline) is CLOSED as fixture-tested. Delivered as a 3-PR sequential chain (budget split): #232 (config+resolver), #233 (run-check gotcha + base-branch addendum), #234 (GitLab YAML + drift-guard + CP-A2a review fix). All merged to feature/v2.0.0.

Verified: job parity 1:1 (GOVERNANCE_JOBS mirrored, REQUIRED normal / DETECTION allow_failure:true), dual drift-guard with the generalized wiring pattern, M1 closed via the canonical shared module (issue-ref-patterns.mjs CLOSING_RE/CHAIN_RE, verified in all three consumers — issue-link, run-check, actor-check), ADR-0018 draft with the include: residual written honestly ("inert until included" + F1 inheritance = citable doctrine). Suite 1132/1132.

NEXT — CP-A2b as a RUNBOOK-LITE (no intermediate checkpoint; proportional ceremony — nothing irreversible): live validation against the PUBLIC gitlab.com mirror (human already configured: public project, VCS_TOKEN masked, "Pipelines must succeed" active). Deliverable: a runbook the human executes with (1) mirror re-push + SHA verification (ls-remote gitlab == origin), (2) the exact include: line for the mirror root .gitlab-ci.yml, (3) TWO test MRs pre-drafted (non-compliant no-issue-link → BLOCKED at rung 1; compliant → passes), (4) evidence to capture (both pipelines' logs, merge-check state). The runbook comes to the human, human reviews + executes. SCIT self-hosted validation is a LATER environment-specifics smoke (CE version, proxy, runners) when access + a new endpoint are restored.

Follow-ups (own slices): CP-A2b (this runbook), A3 (GitLab provider verbs — closes m3 actor-check gh-hardcoded gap), GitHub-bash default-branch unification, plus Track-C leftovers (C3, finding 8, skip:memory-gate, schemaVersion guard, MAJOR-1 engram#589). Related: [[pattern/parity-table-before-implementing]], [[findings/github-issuelink-bash-hardcoded-main]].
